method.match_review: Inspected substantive candidate spans and source context, distinguishing SVG geometry, procedural noise, standard GLSL interpolation, metadata, generic CSS/DOM/nav markup and local browser-test boilerplate. method.asset_review: Reviewed inline SVGs and data-URI bodies as well as external implementation references. method.rights_boundary: The absence of a detected match does not prove independent authorship. Replacement images do not clear implementation rights. Public preview access and automated generation are not permission. No legal-compliance guarantee is made.
